scope: LA-first site screening and high-fidelity construction strategy; no site admission, data analysis or scene build

sources.title: Caltrans District 7 Mobility Performance Report, 2025 Q2
sources.read: PDF pp. 4–5 (zero-based 3–4), findings and Table 1; table text inspected
sources.finding: Table is explicitly for calendar 2024. Adams I110-N #4, Vernon I110-S #9, Robertson I10-W #7, Howard Hughes I405-S #2. District detector-health warning requires station-level checks.
sources.limits: Not a 2026 site ranking; report has a 5/1/2025 footer despite Q2 cover. No individual station records read.

sources.title: Caltrans 2026 HOV Facilities Degradation Action Plan
sources.read: PDF p.49 (printed p.44), Action Plan for HOT Facilities on I-110
sources.finding: Adams north HOT terminus release depends on signals; I110 assessment used Metro data and limited PeMS data.
sources.limits: Managed-lane terminus finding does not establish cause of every adjacent general-purpose-lane bottleneck; proposed projects not treated as completed.

sources.title: Caltrans PeMS Data Source
sources.finding: Free account application; detector archive and auxiliary sources; historical speed-processing changes.
sources.limits: Sam account status, station health, ramp coverage and file terms unknown.

sources.title: NOAA/USGS 2023–2024 Los Angeles County and Channel Islands lidar DEM metadata
sources.read: Abstract, temporal coverage, CRS, access, accuracy and processing metadata
sources.finding: 2023–24 acquisition; 0.5 m ground DEM, LAS 1.4 and breakline deliverables described; CC0 listing. Multiple projected CRSs in catalog require per-file verification.
sources.limits: No selected corridor tile, LAS header, deck coverage or accuracy independently inspected. Grid resolution and project-wide accuracy are not local road accuracy.

sources.title: USGS Lidar Base Specification: DEM Surface Treatments
sources.finding: Bridge decks removed from bare-earth surface; terrain beneath interpolated.
sources.limits: Specification explains DEM limitation; actual bridge returns must be inspected.

sources.title: FHWA Traffic Analysis Toolbox III, 2019, Chapter 2
sources.read: Data for travel conditions, bottleneck throughput, travel time, calibration and quality checks
sources.finding: Concurrent field evidence, localized bottleneck and system-level measures, data quality and travel-condition classification.
sources.limits: Guidance, not validation of this project or prescription for its numerical tolerances.

sources.title: FHWA Traffic Analysis Toolbox III, 2019, Chapter 5
sources.read: Calibration process, variation envelopes and throughput parameters
sources.finding: Representative travel conditions; speed/travel-time and bottleneck measures; constrain adjustable parameters.
sources.limits: Our A/B/C and matched-controller requirements come from approved project contracts and remain additional.

sources.title: Ameli et al., CIRCLES methodology, arXiv:2404.15533v1 (2024)
sources.read: Abstract and sections 3.2–3.3, network creation and supply/HDV calibration
sources.finding: SUMO network and map checks; separate demand/supply inputs; calibration to flow and speed; behavioral sensitivity.
sources.limits: Methods reading only, no replication; one CIRCLES source family, not independent proof of our communication effects or LA transfer.

sources.title: LA City LARIAC7 participation record
sources.limits: Not fully read; source/entitlement lead only. USC membership and offline export/derivative permissions unverified; not an adopted asset.

sources.title: USC ITS Computing Centers
sources.read: Official indexed software-list excerpt; direct page returned 502
sources.finding: ArcGIS Pro listed in computing centers with account requirement.
sources.limits: Does not establish Sam's license, CityEngine access or imagery entitlement. Older USC software page has retirement warning; SSI page timed out.

sources.title: NVIDIA Isaac Sim 6.0 RTX Lidar documentation
sources.finding: Lidar returns depend on nonvisual material properties; scene rendering alone does not specify sensor response.
sources.limits: Platform capability, not measured real-sensor fidelity. Sensor/perception training is not added to present study.

sources.finding: Proposed elevated terminus connector; relevant evidence of topology/epoch complexity.
sources.limits: Planning record, not as-built geometry or confirmation construction occurred.
